authorization: Owner requested continued generation of missing images, with fidelity to the Alien franchise.
scope: Nine existing asph-msn-* mission dressing slots; 33 hub slots remain without image assets.
sourcePolicy: The nine original generated PNGs are copied byte-for-byte. Canvas samples declared windows and uses uniform scaling inside fixed clipped slots. No source pixels are resized, re-encoded or edited.
fidelityScope: The primary images establish the material and construction language of Alien: Isolation. The Asphodele assemblies, labels and slot dimensions are original project adaptations. No pixel-perfect or canonical 1:1 replica certification is claimed.

generation.prompt: Generate ONE production game sprite, a wall-mounted industrial service panel for Aliens: Tantalus Frontier / Asphodèle. Use the supplied actual Alien: Isolation reference photographs for the faithful 1979 Alien / Alien Isolation practical prop design language: off-white aged metal front plates, heavy dark graphite supporting frame, chunky physical catches, rounded rectangular pressed-metal recesses, visible bolts, dark brown / grey / worn beige palette, subdued abrasion. This is an original service-panel assembly in that documented visual language, not a copy of the save terminal: do not include a telephone or text. Front elevation EXACTLY orthographic, screen plane parallel to the entire face, no isometric angle, no visible top or lateral faces, no perspective, no floor, no background or atmospheric setting. One complete closed service panel, broad rectangular silhouette with width:height exactly 128:112 (8:7), four mounting rivets, 2 recessed access plates, a few restrained mechanical vents, a narrow worn ochre-and-black hazard stripe across its bottom edge (about 5/112 of panel height). No screen, no lights, no human, no creature, no logos, no numbers, no letters, no fake labeling. The panel must fill most of the image with only a small fully transparent margin. Real alpha transparency around its contour, no opaque black background, no checkerboard artwork, no ground or cast shadow. High-quality detailed realistic game texture, naturally lit from slightly above left but broad neutral illumination so the whole form reads when downsampled to 128 by112 pixels. Avoid cinematic darkness, teal glow, lens effects, photographic depth of field and cartoon/vector treatment. Preserve a clean horizontal/vertical silhouette and functional late-1970s industrial construction.

observedInvariants: One closed service panel; two inset access plates, rivets and a hazard stripe.
